### Intended Final Products 

Our final product will be an interactive website presenting our research questions, data sources, analyses and plots depicting our results. A dashboard will also be included for people to click through to view specific findings. 

### Anticipated Data Sources

Data source for the project: https://github.com/doehm/survivoR. This is a collection of datasets on various variables from Survivor, such as performance statistics, players, and votes.
